subject: Hosted API tier realignment & monthly commit increase - Greenline Labs
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API renewal options & commit increase

Hi Sara —

Hope you had a good week. We're starting the renewal conversation for Greenline's Hosted API plan that comes up at the end of July. Based on usage trends and the burst patterns we've observed, I want to propose a structured increase to the monthly commit so you get predictable pricing and smoother burst handling. High level: 

- Current baseline: 2,000,000 tokens/month (hosted)
- Proposed commit: 5,500,000 tokens/month (12-month term option)
- Suggested rate: volume-tiered with a 7% uplift discount on the committed bucket vs list rates
- Burst handling: automatic soft-throttle at 110% of committed tokens with a daily burst credit allowance to handle spikes

If you prefer a gentler ramp, we can structure a 3-month step-up (2M -> 4M -> 5.5M) and prorate billing. I attached a short one-pager in the follow-up that lays out the math and a draft term addendum.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync early next week to walk through the numbers and procurement needs?

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Sara Patel <sara@greenlinelabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal options & commit increase

Thanks Kimberly —

Appreciate the heads-up. A couple quick questions before we lock a call: 

1) What's the per-token effective price at the 5.5M commit level (after the 7% discount)? We need a line item for finance.
2) Can you confirm the soft-throttle behavior and whether we get any grace/burst credits rather than immediate throttling? Spikes from our mobile workers tend to be short but frequent.
3) Our procurement team will want a rollback clause in case usage drops after Q1 next year.

We're generally open to a 12-month term if the ramp and throttle protections are clear. I can bring Mike (CFO) into the thread after I get the pricing line.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Platform, Greenline Labs
sara@greenlinelabs.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API renewal options & commit increase — pricing ask

Marissa / Karthik —

Heads-up: Greenline is interested but needs an explicit per-token line and a rollback concession. Proposed quick structure for approval: 

- Effective per-token price at 5.5M commit: $0.00085/token (post 7% committed discount) — this is illustrative, open to rounding per finance.
- Ramp option: 3-month step-up (2M / 4M / 5.5M) with prorated billing in months 1 and 2.
- Throttle policy: soft-throttle at 110% with daily burst credits equal to 10% of monthly commit to absorb short spikes; beyond that standard overage rates apply.
- Rollback clause: allow a single mid-term adjustment (down to 80% of committed tokens) after 90 days with a one-time administrative fee.

Can we offer a 7% volume discount and a one-time 10% onboarding credit applied to the first invoice? Would Legal/Finance be comfortable with the rollback concession above? This is deal GL-2026-178.

Thanks —
Kimberly

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@greenlinelabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal: Greenline Hosted API commit & soft-throttle terms (attached)

Hi Sara —

Per our notes, attached is an updated proposal and a draft committed-terms addendum: Greenline_Proposal_v1.pdf and committed_terms_v2.docx. Summary below: 

- Monthly committed tokens: 5,500,000 (12-month term)
- Effective unit price: $0.00085/token (7% committed discount off list)
- Ramp alternative: 3-month step-up (2M -> 4M -> 5.5M) with prorated charges for months 1–2
- Soft-throttle & burst credits: soft-throttle at 110% of monthly commit; automatic daily burst credits equal to 10% of monthly commit (resets each day) to cover micro-spikes; sustained overage billed at list overage rate
- Rollback: single mid-term adjustment down to 80% of committed tokens after 90 days, subject to a $2,500 administrative fee
- One-time onboarding credit: 10% credit applied to first invoice upon signed DocuSign

If this looks good I can generate a DocuSign envelope (I included the link below) and route to your procurement. Also happy to jump on a short call if Mike wants to review the numbers live. 

DocuSign (proposal): https://www.docusign.com/sign/GL-2026-178

Thanks —
Kimberly
Attachements: Greenline_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal summary), committed_terms_v2.docx (term addendum)

From: Sara Patel <sara@greenlinelabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Green <mike.green@greenlinelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal: Greenline Hosted API commit & soft-throttle terms (attached)

Thanks Kimberly —

The numbers and the burst-credit wording look promising. A few follow-ups from procurement & finance: 

- Mike (cc'd) asked if the 10% onboarding credit can be applied to the second invoice instead of the first to help with month-one cash flow.
- We'd like a clearer rollback trigger — procurement prefers a business-metric-based trigger (e.g., average monthly usage for trailing 60 days falls below 70% of commit) rather than an ad-hoc request.
- Security wants the SOC 2 report and a short note on data retention and logs (we'll provide the standard questionnaire next).

If you can update the addendum with the rollback trigger language and confirm the SOC 2 / retention links, we can move to signature next week. We'll aim to sign by 7/9 if legal gets the revised language.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Platform, Greenline Labs

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline next steps — finalize addendum & SOC2 delivery

Team —

Quick recap and asks so we can hit the 7/9 signature target: 

1) Update committed_terms_v2.docx: replace the administrative rollback clause with a metric trigger "trailing 60-day average usage < 70% of committed tokens" to allow a one-time down-adjustment.
2) Confirm onboarding credit application: Sara asked for credit to be applied to invoice #2; Finance OK to accept if we prorate month 1 as discussed.
3) SOC 2 & retention: attach SOC 2 Type II link and short retention statement to the DocuSign package. I'll pull the SOC2 link from our security page and paste into the addendum.
4) DocuSign envelope: Kimberly to prepare with attachments Greenline_Proposal_v1.pdf + committed_terms_v2.docx + SOC2.pdf link.

I'll make the doc edits and circulate a new envelope by EOD. Karthik — please confirm the effective unit price rounding and that Finance is OK applying the onboarding credit to invoice 2. Vivek / Marissa — flag anything else you want in the addendum before I send.

Thanks —
Kimberly
